description: Internal triage: enum state equality in acceptArbitrationTerms, not equality on an externally manipulable balance or timestamp.
reason: AgreementState.Uninitialized is a discrete lifecycle value. Accepting only this state prevents rewriting consent after funding. Timestamp-based expiry is checked separately with a range comparison. No balance or clock equality controls this guard.
reviewScope: Internal source review and production-controls regression; not independent audit approval
